title: OpenQuest — Innovation Challenge
description: OpenQuest is a flagship hackathon organized by Vasavi Open Source Community (VOSC) at Vasavi College of Engineering. Form teams of 3–4 members, choose from six technology domains, identify a real-world problem, and build an innovative working prototype. The event encourages open-source collaboration, responsible innovation, and practical problem-solving.

title: Open Source Contribution Bootcamp
description: Join us in contributing to real open-source projects. Week-long intensive.

title: Web Dev with React
description: Building modern web applications with React. Full workshop recording available.

title: Hack & Build
description: Collaborate, build and showcase your open-source projects. All skill levels welcome.

title: Domain Discovery
description: Find your domain and begin your open-source journey. Domain Discovery helps students explore different technical domains, discover their interests, and find opportunities to contribute to open source.

title: Git Session
description: Learn the basics of version control and Git workflows. This session introduces students to Git, GitHub, repository management, and collaborative development.

title: RepoQuest
description: Learn to navigate and understand large repositories and codebases.

title: ProposalCraft
description: Learn how to structure effective proposals.

title: Bug Blitz
description: Learn how to identify and fix bugs efficiently.

title: The Great Merge
description: Learn how to perform successful code merges.
